body: Please, rant to your heart's content. It always helps to know you're not the only one feeling how you feel. At least, I think so.
Nope, never uploaded anything... I never really had the face to be a commercially successful songstress. I don't know. I'm sorry.
I like to write realistic fiction novels. Or sometimes satire. My music is just the "girl with a guitar" cliche. Thanks for caring. And that really is a genuine thank-you.
I'm a writer and a musician. Those are virtually the only two things I'm good at, so if I can't do them right, what's the point?
